developerPostmortem.title: SUSPICIOUS: Deploy script reading .env.production (PID 7823) — review required
developerPostmortem.description:
## Summary

A deploy script run by `deploy-bot` accessed `.env.production` during a production release. The network traffic was internal only. Score: 45/100 (SUSPICIOUS).

## Why This Was Flagged

Production environment files may contain secrets. If this access is expected, add it to the allowlist.
actionItems: Verify deploy-bot account credentials are rotated and scoped to minimum required permissions.
Move secrets from .env.production to a secrets manager (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).
Add this deploy pattern to the ZeroTrace allowlist once verified.
